protocol.gate: Do not launch full transport reconstruction if observed-flux increment relative error>=1 or >half links have unresolved internal boundaries
protocol.windows: First24 nonoverlapping12-pair link windows in date/link order; no assessment-based selection
protocol.Gaussian_controls: Q positive diagonal, boundary knots linear trend+intercept; prior SD .1/1/10; fixed, joint profile, analytic marginal
protocol.restriction: Algebraic boundary attenuation diagnostic on public observations, not a transport predictive score
